top_signals.title: The Double Alignment Problem: Civil-Military Relations in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
top_signals.summary:
Artificial intelligence poses the greatest challenge to American civil-military relations since the advent of the nuclear bomb. AI plays outside the political bounds that contain other challenges, however odious. It compounds the inherent problem of civil-military relations – aligning the state and the military – with an additional alignment problem: that of human and agent. In doing so, AI threatens to undermine the constitutionalism and professionalism on which status quo civil-military relations depend.
